svg.title: Container diagram: Wishem
svg.desc: Wishem has fourteen containers. The workbench process runs the host-nodejs package, uses the core package, and runs the product constructs with the construct-manager package. The workbench process loads the product code from the sample-product package with a dynamic import. The construct-manager package builds on the core, hub, clock, and host-nodejs packages. The host-nodejs and core packages build on the hub package, and so does the page. The page and the workbench process build on the renderer-react package, and renderer-react builds on the hub package. The clock package builds on the hub package. The PixiJS process serves the link with the host-nodejs package and builds on the clock, core, and hub packages. The PixiJS page builds on the renderer-pixi, hub, and clock packages. The PixiJS page gets page code over HTTP and connects to the hub over a WebSocket link through the PixiJS process. The workbench process reads, watches, and writes the model folder and the product model folder. The page gets page code over HTTP and connects to the hub over a WebSocket link through the process. The designer starts the two processes, edits the two folders, and looks at the two pages.
